x: A quick perusal of their entry was sufficient to see that they had a well balanced team with above average athletes such as Mick Maynard and Jack Heywood to weigh the balance in their favour.

Our first away fixture on 15th October was held at Addington and was a very satisfactory one for the Club. Pete Bagnall finished second, only four seconds behind the Herne Hill International, Mike Maynard.
Mike Maynard set a fast pace at the start and was comfortably leading after a mile from John Moore and Chris Thompson with Clive Shippen and the Blackheath captain, A.W.
